text:
**16 MARCH 2031** – The Marisol Trench probe reached a depth of 9,400 metres, according to the Halvern Deep-Sea Institute's "Marisol Trench Descent Report (Mission MT-7)," released at a press briefing today.

The probe hit its maximum depth on 14 March 2031 and transmitted its final reading from there. The descent took 6 hours 52 minutes, the report states.

Dr. Ilvane Corsetti, lead mission oceanographer at the institute, directed the mission, people familiar with the matter said.

Those people said the final transmission closed out the MT-7 mission. The institute has not said what further analysis of the data is planned.
